summary: Iteration 7 — Frontend-only validation of the Neo-Brutalism UI redesign + Admin Dashboard (Emergent Google Auth) on the deployed preview URL. All 12 requested behaviors verified. HOME (mobile 390x844): brutalist top card with brand 'FIX MY AREA' + '29 issues reported nearby' metadata, filter pills (all/pothole/garbage/streetlight/water/other) all present, FAB 'REPORT AN ISSUE', locate-me + toggle-list, bottom nav (nav-map / nav-my-issues), admin-portal-link, sign-in/theme-toggle all render and are visible/clickable. THEME: data-theme flips light→dark on click (localStorage 'fma-theme' set to 'dark'), body bg computed to rgb(13,13,13) (#0D0D0D), persists across page reload. MAP: MapLibre canvas renders, emoji pins '.cf-emoji-pin' present with correct emoji ('🗑️' for garbage), '.cf-cluster' with count '25' clickable — clicking easeTos into zoom and cluster split from 2→1 clusters, and clicking an individual emoji pin navigates to /issue/{id}. User dot '.cf-userpin' renders. Filter pill 'pothole' toggles active state (cyan/yellow class change) and filters markers with no JS errors. NAV: nav-my-issues → /my-issues (URL updated), nav-map → / works round-trip. ADMIN (desktop 1440x900) — cookie admin_token=<seeded>: (1) SUPER (test_super_sess): 5 metric cards Total=29/Pending=23/In Progress=2/Resolved=4/Rejected=0, status+category filters, 29 issue rows, 'Pending admin requests (1)' section with approve-/reject- buttons visible, category filter → 23 pothole rows. EditPanel shows category+assignee+team+status(Pending/In Progress/Resolved/Rejected)+note+save. (2) GOV (test_gov_sess): 27 jurisdiction-scoped rows (excludes 2 non-Haryana), assignee dropdown lists 'Unassigned' and 'BuildRight Pvt Ltd', all edit controls present. (3) CONTRACTOR (test_contractor_sess): EXACTLY 2 rows shown (scoped to assigned issues), EditPanel correctly HIDES admin-category-select / admin-assignee-select / admin-team-input (count=0) and shows ONLY admin-status-select + admin-note-input + admin-save-btn — matches RBAC spec. (4) test_new_sess actually resolves to a pending-approval admin (profile_complete=true, status=pending) so it correctly renders admin-pending-screen with 'Awaiting approval' copy (NOT the ProfileForm — see note below). NO console errors from ThemeContext, MapLibre, or admin pages (only 2 benign 401s on non-super endpoints during super's initial render).

ui_bugs.issue: When the list panel is open, its z-[1050] wrapper covers the toggle-list-btn (z-[1000] at bottom-56), so tapping the same button to close the list is intercepted by the drawer's IssueCard subtree. User must scroll/close via other means. Fix: raise toggle-list-btn z-index above 1050 while open, or add an explicit close chevron inside the drawer header.

issues: Brand title 'FIX MY AREA' wraps to two lines ('FIX MY / AREA') because the card packs brand + metadata + 5 top-control buttons (theme, admin, EN/हिं, sign-in) into a 390px row. Consider hiding the ADMIN label on <400px (already sm:hidden) — but the language pill and sign-in green button dominate; shrink paddings or truncate/allow one-line clip.

action_items: (LOW) Raise toggle-list-btn z-index above the list drawer OR add an explicit close button inside the drawer so users can close the panel without map-area workaround.
(LOW/UX) Trim TopControls padding at <400px to keep brand 'FIX MY AREA' on one line when metadata + 5 controls all render.

(INFO for main agent / doc) The request labeled test_new_sess as the 'first-time profile' scenario, but the seeded backend record for that token has profile_complete=true & status=pending — so the frontend correctly shows the admin-pending-screen (Awaiting approval), NOT the ProfileForm with role-government/role-contractor buttons. If the ProfileForm needs automated coverage, add a NEW seeded session (e.g. test_incomplete_sess) whose admin row has profile_complete=false so the ProfileForm branch of AdminPortal renders. Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md accordingly.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPortal.jsx renders both super-only endpoints (/api/admin/requests, /api/admin/contractors) via useQuery on every mount; for gov/contractor these return 401 and show as console errors even though the UI degrades gracefully. Gate these queries with `enabled: me?.role === 'super_admin'` (or role !== 'private_contractor' for /contractors) to eliminate the 401 noise.
MapHome.jsx: list drawer uses z-[1050] while locate-me/toggle-list FABs are z-[1000]; either move the FAB column to z-[1100] or move the drawer to z-[1030] so the toggle is not obscured when open.

ThemeContext.jsx: initialTheme() reads localStorage inline during useState init — works, but adding a `prefers-color-scheme` fallback would be nicer default UX before the user has toggled. Not blocking.
TopControls.jsx accepts a `compact` prop from MapHome but never uses it; either remove the prop or actually shrink control set on compact=true.

MapView.jsx theme dark path relies on a CSS filter applied via `.cf-map-dark` on the container — verify (via CSS) that the filter targets only the canvas child, not the overlay markers (.cf-emoji-pin/.cf-cluster) which are positioned by MapLibre inside the same container and would otherwise be inverted. Visually the emojis look correct in the dark screenshot, so probably scoped correctly, but worth confirming in index.css.

success_rate.backend: not tested (frontend-only run per request; admin APIs sanity-curled: /admin/me returns 200 for all 4 seeded tokens)

test_credentials: Admin cookie admin_token=test_super_sess | test_gov_sess | test_contractor_sess | test_new_sess (this last one = Fresh Admin, profile_complete=true, status=pending → pending screen). Set as httpOnly false cookie with domain=report-now-8.preview.emergentagent.com, sameSite=None, secure=true.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the 4 pre-seeded admin sessions and the 29 pre-seeded issues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Neo-brutalism redesign + Admin RBAC + theme system all pass on the deployed preview. Key selectors: [data-testid=theme-toggle] (html data-theme + localStorage fma-theme), .cf-emoji-pin / .cf-cluster / .cf-userpin (MapLibre overlay), [data-testid=filter-chip-{all|pothole|garbage|streetlight|water|other}], [data-testid=report-issue-fab|locate-me-btn|toggle-list-btn|nav-map|nav-my-issues|admin-portal-link]. Admin: metric-Total|Pending|'In progress'|Resolved|Rejected (mixed case!), admin-row-{id}, admin-{category-select|assignee-select|team-input|status-select|note-input|save-btn|panel-close}, approve-{id}/reject-{id}, admin-pending-screen, and profile-form testids role-government/role-contractor/admin-profile-submit (NOT covered — no seeded incomplete admin). Contractor RBAC correctly hides category/assignee/team controls. The Only two minor UX issues are: (a) list drawer z-index blocks toggle-btn on close, (b) brand title wraps on mobile <400px when logged in. Neither is a functional blocker. Also: consider gating super-only useQuery hooks with `enabled:` to silence 2 benign 401 console errors on gov/contractor role.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bug this iteration. Two minor UX z-index/typography items and a doc mismatch (test_new_sess is pending-approval, not new-profile) documented in action_items.
